svg.title: Arteries advanced tech and production tree
svg.desc: A proposed five-branch technology DAG with research, production, and transport side branches. Each discovery requires research, prerequisite technologies, and a specific combination of goods present in a settlement. Routing goods together is how the player guides technological progress.
svg.text: The player guides discovery by routing goods into the same settlement. Side branches tune research, production, and throughput.
after Mathematics + Education · Cloth 4 + Tools 4 + Machinery 1
after Crop rotation + Masonry · Grain 6 + Bricks 2
after Bulk handling + Mathematics · Tools 2 + Machinery 1
for at least one market day
No tech unlocks from research alone.
Side branches still need the same gate.
PRODUCTION Sawmills · Bloomery · Looms · Tooling · Irrigation
TRANSPORT Bulk handling · Logistics · Rail/Harbor · Customs
Each is optional; each changes the next research or transport step.
GATE goods together · AFTER tech prereqs
EFFECT recipe, mode, or throughput boost
Arteries prototype · proposed advanced tree · routing choices assemble the research environment
